result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major loading/rendering issue with a restaurant image, and one minor layout truncation issue.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner overlay, indicating the image has not fully loaded or is stuck in a loading state.
issues.suggestion: Investigate image loading performance and ensure proper fallback/placeholder images are shown while content loads. Consider implementing lazy loading with a smooth fade-in once images are ready, and add error handling to show a placeholder if the image fails to load.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal scroll section ('Trattoria Piccol...') has its name truncated mid-word, which looks unpolished even for a carousel peek pattern.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to restaurant names in carousel cards so truncation ends cleanly with '…' rather than cutting off mid-word.
